description:

author: Forbes
description: At 27, Cambridge graduate Saaras Mehan started Jack and Jill with a simple frustration: hiring is broken on both sides.⁣ ⁣ So he built an AI agent that helps candidates navigate the entire process—while connecting companies directly with the right talent.⁣ ⁣ Now backed by $19M, it’s quickly becoming a new way to hire.⁣
title: Meet the 27-Year-Old Building the Future of Hiring

author: Forbes
description:
@CyrusVeyssi first went viral *by accident.* (Iconic.)

The internet's self-proclaimed “bougie gay uncle” skyrocketed to fame for their hilarious, self-shot videos, which often feature their father, @YourFavoriteBaba.

"I started to build that character online and it became this sort of intersection between myself and a performance," Veyssi tells host Kim Peiffer (@PeifferK1) on this week's episode of #ForbesTaksShop. "Finding the places where I could incorporate my organic voice into joy and into characters has been my focus.”

This week, Veyssi kicks off Season Two to discuss the routines and tools that fuel their success.

description:
Cyrus Veyssi has mastered the art of the pivot. In this episode of Forbes Talks Shop, host Kim Peiffer sits down with the creator, beauty expert and self-proclaimed “Bougie Gay Uncle” to talk about building a career in the creator economy, protecting your mental health online and the $29 tool that changed their content game.

Cyrus shares the story behind their viral breakout, opens up about debuting Botox in their “safe space” series and explains why they’re returning to their acting roots with sights set on Broadway. Whether you’re an aspiring creator or just looking to refine your skincare routine, this conversation is full of insight, honesty and a few standout product recommendations.
